composition_label: Adaptive onboarding (Guided onboarding) -> Feedback analysis (Customer insights)

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, profile, feedback. Profile: experience beginner/intermediate/advanced, preference guided/concise, nonempty unique goals start/sell/track, unique completed_steps account/listings/analytics. Feedback records: unique nonblank id, selected step_id, nonblank text with word characters.
shared_schema.output: Strict object: schema_version=1, status=ok, synthetic=true, onboarding, feedback. Onboarding carries profile, ordered steps and exact source_feedback. Feedback carries counts, deduplicated groups and traceable themes.
shared_schema.validation: One recursive validator handles all structural schemas; shared semantic checks enforce profile constraints, completed prerequisites, handoff order/status, selected feedback targets and unique source IDs. Unknown fields, wrong types, boolean versions, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite JSON constants are rejected.
shared_schema.errors: File, encoding, JSON and validation errors print one JSON object with status=error and exit 2; success prints one JSON object and exits 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Validated ONBOARDING object is the only feedback-stage input. It includes exact feedback records, adapted profile and prerequisite-ordered steps.
cross_stage_handoffs.propagation: Groups inherit the onboarding step's completion status. Recommendations inherit experience/preference and reference the relevant selected steps in prerequisite order. Exact source IDs and excerpts survive normalization and grouping.

behavior.onboarding: Resolve goal dependency closure account -> listings -> analytics. Include completed steps without repeat tasks. Guided beginners receive three instructions, guided intermediates two, advanced or concise users one. Explain prerequisites, experience and preference choices.
behavior.deduplication: NFKC normalization, case folding, word extraction and whitespace collapse; key includes step_id so identical text about different steps is not merged. Preserve first-seen group order and every exact source excerpt.
behavior.themes: Deterministic exact-word keyword matching, multiple themes allowed, otherwise other. Themes sort by name and cite all supporting group IDs and source records. No inferred sentiment or statistical significance.
behavior.empty_feedback: Valid; zero counts and empty groups/themes.
behavior.fixtures: All example and test records are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, timestamps, providers, environment-driven decisions or mutation of input documents.

included: Deduplication, keyword themes, exact excerpt traceability
Synthetic fixture and standard-library unittest suite
excluded: Live LLM calls or injected LLM steps
Persistent storage, web UI, authentication or production deployment
Multilingual theme dictionaries and statistical analysis

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed; printed one valid JSON object with status=ok
